protocols.name: cell cryopreservation
steps: Harvest cells at 70-80% confluency
Centrifuge at 300g for 5 minutes
Resuspend in freezing medium (90% FBS + 10% DMSO)
Aliquot into cryovials
Cool at -1°C/min to -80°C using controlled rate freezer
Transfer to liquid nitrogen for long-term storage

protocols.name: FITC-dextran permeability assay
steps: Fast mice for 4 hours prior to assay
Administer FITC-dextran (600 mg/kg) by oral gavage
Collect blood samples at 0.5, 1, 2, and 4 hours
Measure fluorescence in serum using plate reader
Calculate permeability from AUC

protocols.name: ELISA for CRP detection
steps: Coat plates with capture antibody overnight at 4°C
Block with 1% BSA for 1 hour at room temperature
Add samples and standards, incubate 2 hours
Add detection antibody, incubate 1 hour
Add HRP conjugate, incubate 30 minutes
Add TMB substrate, stop with sulfuric acid
Read absorbance at 450nm

protocols.name: bioelectrochemical CO2 fixation
steps: Prepare H-cell electrochemical reactor
Inoculate with Sporomusa ovata culture
Set cathode potential to -400mV vs SHE
Purge with CO2/H2 (80:20) gas mixture
Monitor acetate production via HPLC
Maintain pH 7.0 with automated titration
